name: Brad "The Love Machine" Morris
caption: Half of the Love Connection tag team, speaking from his own hotel suite in a November 1998 roleplay, with a bandage over his right eye after a chair shot at the pay-per-view.
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id lefAS_a1IUAJ, 23 November 1998), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/love-connection-roleplay-tell-me-what-you-think-1998-11-23.html. In the roleplay he owns the hotel the Love Connection stays in, shoves a fan away, and cuts a promo at Nick Demola, Crack and Smack (the Brothers from Hell) and Desolation Row, claiming a title shot after the pay-per-view.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/love-connection-roleplay-tell-me-what-you-think-1998-11-23.html (the post's own opening line puts the Love Connection 'of the UUW'; the roleplay cuts a promo at the UUW's Nick Demola and the tag champions)

identity.note: The UUW's Love Machine is not tied by any card to the two held wrestlers billed Brad Morris (GSWA in July 1997; Damage in July 1997): no shared operator, roster or text. Filed distinct.

name: "All Natural" Lance Love
caption: The other half of the Love Connection tag team, who tells the tag champions in a November 1998 roleplay that the belts belong around "the two sexiest waists in the UUW".
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_id lefAS_a1IUAJ, 23 November 1998), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/love-connection-roleplay-tell-me-what-you-think-1998-11-23.html. He plays the laughing sidekick to Brad Morris, flirts with the ladies in the suite's whirlpool, and promises Crack and Smack a first-class introduction to the pop.

identity.note: Shares a bare ring name with Lance Love of the SCW entity (Tennessee Championship match, 28 February 1999); no card or text ties the two. Filed distinct.
